Acting junior councillor (gon-shōsanji): seven members. This is the last of Toyohashi-han's councillor offices; its seven holders are among the name-block printed in the lower register below.

宮脇正成・松尾正徳・游佐高園・杉本良貴・五味高徳・藤本有常・小野長愿・石川景祥

Lower-register block of eight named Toyohashi-han officials, read right-to-left: Miyawaki Masanari, Matsuo Masanori, Yusa Takasono, Sugimoto Yoshitaka, Gomi Takanori, Fujimoto Aritsune, Ono Naga(yoshi?), Ishikawa Kageyoshi. The rightmost (Miyawaki) heads a higher grade whose title (少參事) is on the previous leaf p144R; the remaining seven are the 權少參事 七員 named above. NOTE: MASTER assigns these eight names to 德山藩, but they lie to the RIGHT of the ○德山藩 marker and are therefore Toyohashi's (previous-domain) officials — confirmed by p144R (○豐橋藩 + Toyohashi officials begin) and p145R (Tokuyama's real officials 大參事/權大參事/銃兵/砲兵 continue right of ○鳥羽藩).
